description: This file defines an Angular component named PropertyGroupsComponent that displays various property groups and their details for a Layer object in a viewer UI. It includes visualization of visibility, geometry, buffer, hierarchy, effects, and input properties, with methods to process and display specific data points.

classes.name: PropertyGroupsComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that visualizes various property groups of a Layer object, including visibility, geometry, buffer, hierarchy, effects, and input properties.

methods.name: hasInputChannel
methods.description: Checks if the Layer object has input window info, indicating presence of input channel data.

methods.name: getDestinationFrame
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the destination frame's coordinates if available.

methods.name: hasIgnoreDestinationFrame
methods.description: Determines if the item has the ignore destination frame flag set based on its flags.

methods.name: formatFloat
methods.description: Rounds a floating point number to two decimal places.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Generates a summary array of visibility and occlusion reasons for the Layer, used for display purposes.
